gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies both relevant formula defects: the downward product misses the presmoothing factors, and the coarse solve is represented using A_0^{-1} while D_0^+ is set to lambda A. These are the two concrete ways the old formula fails to represent the coefficient-one exact coarse correction and its placement in the symmetric-MG cycle.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 concerns dimensional and product/coarse-solve errors in the symmetric-MG preconditioner construction. It does not recognize the distinct condition-number orientation error involving B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2} versus B^{1/2}AB^{1/2}, so the shared symmetric-MG location and downstream optimality consequence do not establish coverage.
